blocks.text: Nervous system mein neurons impulses lene, bhejne aur process karne ke liye khaas neural raaston (pathways ya arcs) par chalte hain. Kisi raaste mein sirf chand neurons hote hain aur koi zyada pecheeda jaal (network) hota hai. Reflex arc sab se saada neural raasta hai. Yeh reflex action ko qaboo karta hai, yaani bahar ya andar ke stimuli ka fauri, khud ba khud (automatic) aur be-iradah (involuntary) jawab.

Knee-jerk woh reflex hai jo tab hota hai jab koi ghutne ke neeche wali tendon (patellar tendon) par hathore (hammer) se zarb lagaye. Tendon par yeh thapki stimulus hai. Yeh stimulus ran (thigh) ke quadriceps muscle mein maujood receptor mehsoos karta hai. Receptor sensory neuron mein nerve impulse paida karta hai. Sensory neuron yeh impulse spinal cord tak le jata hai. Wahan sensory neuron impulse ko baghair kisi inter-neuron ke seedha motor neuron ko de deta hai. Motor neuron impulse ko effector (quadriceps muscle) tak le jata hai jo sukarta hai. Is se ghutne par nichli taang seedhi (extend) ho jati hai, yaani nichli taang aage ko jhatka khati hai.

blocks.alt: Mure hue ghutne wali taang pehlu se. Hathora (hammer) ghutne ke neeche tendon par lagta hai. Sensory neuron ran ke agle quadriceps muscle ke receptor se spinal cord (kata hua) tak jata hai. Cord ke andar interneuron hai, aur do motor neurons cord se nikalte hain: aik quadriceps ko aur aik ran ke pichle hamstrings muscle ko.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hathore se shuru karein: tendon par zarb, quadriceps ka receptor, sensory neuron spinal cord tak, wahan seedha motor neuron, aur quadriceps sukar kar taang aage phenk deta hai. Spinal cord ke andar chhota interneuron doosra kaam karta hai: woh hamstrings (ran ke peeche ka muscle) ke motor neuron ko rok deta hai taa ke hamstrings dheela rahe.

Isi dauran sensory neuron spinal cord mein ek inter-neuron ko bhi jagata (activate karta) hai. Yeh inter-neuron aise kimiyai madde (chemicals) chhorta hai jo hamstrings muscle tak jane wale motor neurons ko rok dete hain (inhibit karte hain). Is liye jab nichli taang seedhi hoti hai to hamstrings dheela (relax) rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ghutne ka jhatka itna tez kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ka arc bohat chhota hai: sensory neuron spinal cord mein seedha motor neuron se judta hai, beech mein inter-neuron nahin hota aur dimagh ke faisle ka intezar nahin hota.

items: Reflex arc fauri, automatic aur involuntary jawab ka sab se saada raasta hai. Knee-jerk: quadriceps ka receptor, sensory neuron, spinal cord, motor neuron, quadriceps sukarta hai; inter-neuron hamstrings ko dheela rakhta hai.
